shorts.title: This Bird Hunts Black Mambas Longer Than a Bed
shorts.outro: Doug's seven mamba deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: The brown snake eagle weighs about as much as a bag of flour and carries off adult black mambas; Doug's seven mamba deaths are in the full episode.

shorts.title: Black Mamba Venom Hides a Painkiller as Strong as Morphine
shorts.outro: The full mamba video is below.
shorts.description: Mambalgins from black mamba venom matched morphine for pain relief in mice, though they are not a medicine; the full black mamba episode is linked below.

shorts.title: A Black Mamba Can Strike Up to a Meter High
shorts.outro: Doug meets this snake seven times in the full video below.
shorts.description: A cornered black mamba can lift and launch up to 40 percent of its body length, about kitchen-counter height; watch Doug meet it seven times in the full episode.
